method: Read public W3C official pages through the web reader; reviewed only the standard facts used in this package.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2
reviewedFacts: The recommendation lists distinct success criteria for contrast, keyboard access, focus, reflow, and name/role/value.
A color check alone does not establish page conformance.

sources.title: Understanding Contrast (Minimum)
reviewedFacts: Contrast assessment depends on the text and its specific foreground/background pairing; this package does not assert a universal ratio for a product.

sources.title: Developing a Keyboard Interface
reviewedFacts: Custom interactive widgets require deliberate keyboard and focus behavior; the actual pattern depends on the widget.

implementationInferences: Semantic token mapping and staged consumer migration are engineering recommendations, not W3C certification.
